name: Joseph Birkenmayer

events.title: Godfather to his niece Franziska Mayer
events.description: Named as godfather and witness: 'Joseph Birkenmaier, day labourer, 20-year-old single son of the late Servaz Birkenmaier of here'.

bioAdditions: Joseph was still at home in Munzingen in March 1863. When his sister Maria Anna's second child, Franziska (later Frances Meier Miller), was baptized on 10 Mar 1863, the godfather was 'Joseph Birkenmaier, Taglöhner, twenty-year-old single son of the late Servaz Birkenmaier of here'. He also signed as a witness (S1). The age fits his birth on 15 Mar 1842 exactly. So he emigrated to Ohio after March 1863. A Sandusky obituary (Nov 1904) is still unread: the Hayes Ohio Obituary Index search page could not be driven from here, and the Erie County USGenWeb obituary page has no Birkenmeier.
openQuestionsNew: Emigration falls between Mar 1863 and his appearance in Ohio. Check the Bezirksamt Freiburg Auswanderungsakten, 1863–1870.
